text:
Sienna: Quick planning thread for the upcoming “Inference Launch Labs” webinar. We need: X thread (4 tweets), LinkedIn long post + 3-card carousel, employee advocacy kit, and clear inbound routing for demo requests. Who can own which parts?

Ravi: I can do X thread + A/B hooks. Plan: Tweet1 hook, Tweet2 stat card, Tweet3 micro-case, Tweet4 CTA + pinned reg link. Will draft two hooks (ops pain vs savings).

Ana: Ill take LinkedIn long-form + carousel frames. Need 3 copy variants: benchmark, product, CX story. Also want a newsletter blurb if we push next week.

Theo: Ill build HubSpot landing/form and routing. Fields: name, company, job_title, company_size, utm_source, interest_area. Form id: webinar_infer_launch_2026. Routing rules?

Sienna: Routing: high touch if job_title contains (SRE|Platform|ML|Infra) OR company_size >=150 -> tag hot -> assign SDRs; else -> nurture. UTM template: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=infer_launch_2026.

Ana: Design asks: hero (1200x628), stat card (1200x675) with small caveat "internal benchmark 1 results vary by workload", square GIF (600x600), 30s vertical clip for stories. Will drop frames in Figma by EOD.

Ravi: Shortlink plan: primary rwd.in/inf-launch, backup rwd.in/inf-l. Use primary in copy, backup in ad settings.

Theo: Routing pseudo for automation (copyable):
``
if job_title in [SRE, ML, Platform, Infra] or company_size >=150:
  tag = hot
  assign = SDRs_high
else:
  tag = nurture
  enroll = webinar_3_touch_seq
```

Sienna: Employee advocacy: ask 25 employees (engineers + PMs) to post within 1 hour of LI/X posts. Provide 3 captions and 2 image options. Ana please craft the kit.

Ana: Will create the employee kit: 3 captions, suggested hashtags (#RedwoodInference #InferenceAtScale), image variants, and one internal talking point per speaker. Drop in /kits by tomorrow.

Ravi: A/B test plan: Hook A ("2x lower per-token cost with batching + cache - internal benchmark"), Hook B ("Cut 99th percentile latency w/ small infra changes"). Run both organically and use sponsored to prioritize the better-performing hook after 12h.

Theo: Post-live follow-ups: attendees -> mark attended=true, push to SDRs if score >=80. Top 50 eng leads -> personalized outreach within 24h; next 150 -> segmented email with recording + gated slides. Ill create saved list webinar_top50_infer_launch_2026.

Sienna: Engagement plan during live: 2 people for replies (product + community), 1 for DMs, 1 to surface hot lead tweets to Theo. Add short FAQ doc & canned replies.

LinkBot: Shortlinks created: https://rwd.in/inf-launch (primary), https://rwd.in/inf-l (backup).

CampaignBot: Promo campaigns drafted (IDs: X-9901, LI-9902). Ads ready after copy approval. Budget ask: $2k (split 60% LinkedIn / 40% X).

Ana: Legal asked that any stat includes the qualifier. Ill append the methodology link in the carousel final card.

Sienna: Owners summary: Ravi -> X thread + schedule; Ana -> LinkedIn + employee kit + assets; Theo -> HubSpot + routing + saved lists; Sienna -> approvals + tracking dashboard. Deadline: copy drafts by Tue 9am PT, Figma assets by Tue EOD. React with :+1: if youre good or flag blockers.
